Evaluate a compact receipt for explicit selectors against compatibility needs; retain full restoration evidence for default/depth reads and genuinely withheld requested content. Preserve canonical identity, requested empty collections, alias/provenance accuracy, exact final serialized token accounting, SDK/CLI/MCP parity and existing output budgets.
